variants.headline: Union calls a strike
variants.body: A union has called a strike in {colony}. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.

variants.headline: A call to withhold labour
variants.body: A strike has been called by a union in the colony. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.

variants.headline: Work becomes the subject of a strike call
variants.body: The colony has a union call for strike action. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.
